'''Abyssin ornaments''' were a type of statue that represented the stylized head of an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]],<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Abyssin Ornament}}</ref> a violent [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> They were used as amulets of protection against bodily harm, as Abyssins were known for their outstanding regenerative abilities.<ref name="CCG" />

On [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gangster [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] possessed several of those ornamental head sculptures, which were attached to [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|his throne]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> One was also placed on the top-deck of the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] warlord [[Terak]] also had Abyssin ornaments mounted on the walls of his [[Terak's Keep|castle]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Sanctuary Moon of Endor]].<ref name="TBFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
These statues were first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which they appeared as ornaments on Jabba the Hutt's personal repulsorsled. The [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]] was the first source to identify them as Abyssin ornaments. There are several morphologic differences between the Abyssins such as [[Myo/Legends|Myo]] and the statues&mdash;the ornaments feature long snouts and sharp teeth while real Abyssins lack those traits.
